title: Vegan Caesar Dressing
notes: Makes 3 Cups. Will keep in fridge up to 3 weeks. Delicious for a dairy-free vegan/vegetarian Caesar salad, or with warm rice or quinoa and veggies.

ingredientSections.heading: Dressing
items: 3 Tbsp Tahini or 2 Tbsp Sesame Seeds blended well with the water
½ tsp Himalayan or Sea Salt

methodSections.heading: Dressing
steps: Soak the sunflower seeds for 4 to 6 hours and then drain and rinse.
Blend hemp hearts, soaked sunflower seeds and water until creamy.
Add all remaining ingredients except the olive oil and blend well.
Once well blended add the olive oil gradually and continue blending until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Vegan Caesar Salad
steps: Chop up the Kale and lettuce, drizzle with dressing, and top with nutritional yeast and croutons.
